title: 'A succulent Chinese meal' - iconic Australian quote immortalised in national archive
summary: Jack Karlson's iconic 1991 arrest rant at a Brisbane Chinese restaurant just got officially preserved by Australia's National Film and Sound Archive. The guy dramatically resisted cops while shouting "A succulent Chinese meal?" and "Gentlemen, this is democracy manifest"—lines that became legendary internet folklore when the clip went viral in 2009. Karlson (real name Cecil Edwards) died in 2024 at 82, but his chaotic energy lived on through memes, remixes, and merch. He always insisted it was mistaken identity—either confused with a Hungarian chess player or caught in an American Express fraud thing. Wild that a random arrest became actual Australian cultural heritage.
